assumptions.choice: Use datetime.weekday() where Monday is 0 and Friday is 4
assumptions.reason: Standard Python datetime convention for identifying calendar days.

assumptions.choice: Calculate position size as floor(cash / (close_price * (1 + commission)))
assumptions.reason: Ensures full utilization of available cash without triggering margin/cash rejections due to transaction commissions.

assumptions.choice: Place stop market order at exactly 2% from fill price upon entry completion, and cancel active stop orders when closing position scheduled on Friday/Monday
assumptions.reason: Prevents orphaned stop loss orders from executing after a scheduled time-based exit has closed the position.
